The real crisis? Hospitals burning billions on admin waste while LA’s Medicaid program fails 48% of limited-English patients.

Prioritize Americans first, audit every dollar, and end the cycle where bureaucrats profit from chaos they created.

The World Trade Center Health Program is a lifeline for heroes who sacrificed everything. But let’s be clear: delays aren’t about funding—they’re about D.C. bureaucrats mismanaging resources. The program’s budget has ballooned to $3.7B annually, yet wait times spike as administrators shuffle cash into redundant studies and bloated overhead.

Every dollar should go directly to survivors, not six-figure “consultants” auditing air quality reports from 2001. Congress must streamline this program, fire the deadweight, and mandate that 90% of funds flow to patient care—not paper-pushers.

Honor their sacrifice by cutting waste, not corners.
